fato_historico: 1944: World War II: Captain Bobbie Brown earns a Medal of Honor for his actions during the Battle of Crucifix Hill, just outside Aachen.

Much like a hero finding strength at a crucial turning point, you might discover that your words have the power to overcome obstacles. It is a good time to lead with your heart and express your authentic self with grace and unwavering inner fortitude.
frase_do_dia: True strength blooms when you speak your truth with a kind heart.
